parts.name: Button
parts.description: A native `<button>` with `type="button"` by default. While disabled your own click, pointer-down, mouse-down and key handlers don't run. For another element, spread the `button` props function on it.

props.name: variant
props.description: The visual emphasis of the action.

props.name: tone
props.description: The color of the action. `destructive` keeps the variant’s emphasis and draws it in the destructive color, for actions that delete or discard. `variant="destructive"` is the filled form.

props.name: size
props.description: The height and padding of the button. Give icon-only buttons an accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the button is disabled. It gets the native `disabled` attribute, or `aria-disabled` with `focusableWhenDisabled`. `disabled={pending? value}` disables it while a request is out. A natively disabled button that had focus takes it back when it is enabled again, if focus hasn't moved elsewhere.

props.name: focusableWhenDisabled
props.description: Whether a disabled button stays focusable and keeps its place in the Tab order. It is then disabled with `aria-disabled="true"` and ignores presses, Enter and Space.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the button is disabled, whether through `disabled` or `aria-disabled`.
